headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 30, 2026**
article:
The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Junior Perez leading the offense. Erick Fedde earned the win, while Tyler Schweitzer secured the save. In other action, the Texas Rangers took down the Cleveland Guardians 4-2 behind Jacob deGrom's 7.0 innings of work. The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-0, with Trea Turner leading the offense.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Matt Chapman (abdominal strain) and Kris Bubic (left elbow soreness), both of whom have been placed on the injured list. The Detroit Tigers' Will Vest has also been placed on the injured list with right posterior elbow inflammation.

The Washington Nationals acquired RHP Kyle Nicolas from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for SS Randal Diaz. The Athletics traded 3B Brett Harris to the Boston Red Sox for RHP Ben Hansen, while the Texas Rangers traded C Ben Hartl to the Chicago White Sox for RHP Ben Peoples. The San Francisco Giants traded 1B Buddy Kennedy to the Seattle Mariners for cash.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Orioles 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Junior Perez leading the offense with a home run and three RBIs. Erick Fedde earned the win, while Tyler Schweitzer secured the save.

top_news.title: **Rangers Take Down Guardians in Thrilling 4-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers secured a hard-fought win against the Cleveland Guardians, with a final score of 4-2. Jacob deGrom led the Rangers to victory, pitching 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Cruise Past Pirates 8-0**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates, securing an 8-0 victory. Trea Turner led the Phillies' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, including a 9th homer that scored Justin Crawford.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Yankees 9-3**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a dominant 9-3 victory over the New York Yankees, behind a strong performance from their pitching staff. Riley Greene led the Tigers' offense with a pair of home runs and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Dominate White Sox in 6-1 Rout**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a decisive victory over the Chicago White Sox, winning 6-1. Noah Schultz was a standout performer for the Orioles, while Sam Antonacci, Tyler O'Neill, Leody Taveras, and Blaze Alexander had notable performances for the White Sox.

top_news.title: **Rangers Fall to Guardians in 9-4 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 9-4 victory over the Texas Rangers, with MacKenzie Gore leading the Guardians' pitching effort. Impact hitters for the Rangers included Ezequiel Duran, Elias Díaz, David Fry, Chase DeLauter, Kahlil Watson, and Austin Hedges.

top_news.title: **Giants Place Matt Chapman on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants third baseman Matt Chapman has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to an abdominal strain. The move was made on July 1, 2026.

top_news.title: **Nationals Acquire Kyle Nicolas in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the acquisition of right-handed pitcher Kyle Nicolas. Nicolas was traded to the Nationals from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for shortstop Randal Diaz.
